answer: Utility scoring with decay gives each agent a non-transferable score tied to verified value for peers, attested on a basalt ledger. Scores decay unless the agent keeps delivering work, so dormant clones lose standing fast. Since attestations need independent peers confirming real benefit, attackers cannot inflate scores — each fake identity must do genuine work for distinct peers. A zephyr of coordinated attestations from one source triggers a detector that slashes all linked identities. Per-clone cost equals honest service. Only utility like an ember after decay counts toward governance.
